hook: HVAC and plumbing owners: *3 questions*. Be honest.
title: The paperwork quiz nobody studies for

questions.q: A new client wants your certificate of insurance today. Which one goes out?
options: The PDF from last year's folder
A current one from your agent
questions.why: Old certificates show old dates. Clients check.

options: All on the same day, nice and tidy
questions.why: Every card, every tech, its own date.

questions.q: The insurance renewal notice goes to...
options: Whoever set up the policy years ago
questions.why: Check which inbox every renewal goes to.
